verdict.rationale: dlt explicitly claims a 'custom destinations' interface that can be used 'to create reverse ETL pipelines' (dlt-docs-3), so the axis is acknowledged, but this is a generic build-your-own-destination mechanism rather than documented, pre-built connectors for CRM/ads/support SaaS tools. All other evidence (REST/SQL/filesystem sources, warehouse/lakehouse/vector destinations, dbt integration) is about extract-load INTO analytical stores, not writing modeled data back OUT to operational SaaS apps. missing for 10: verified reverse-ETL destination connectors (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Google/Facebook Ads, Zendesk), a documented reverse-ETL tutorial/example, and independent confirmation that teams actually activate warehouse data into SaaS tools with dlt.
